detail.title: cp: `build: use PyPI nvidia-cudnn-frontend 1.29.1 in CI dev image (8303)` into `core_r0.20.0`

files.patch:
@@ -121,10 +121,6 @@ COPY megatron/core/package_info.py /workspace/megatron/core/
 ARG IMAGE_TYPE=dev
 ENV IMAGE_TYPE=${IMAGE_TYPE}
 ENV NVTE_BUILD_NUM_PHILOX_ROUNDS=3
-# cuDNN Frontend is replaced after the sync below with this ref of NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend
-# (feat/1.29.0-megatron). Docker-only: outside pyproject.toml and uv.lock. Set empty to keep the
-# locked PyPI wheel. Skipped for the LTS image.
-ARG CUDNN_FRONTEND_GIT_REF=8924d4b41fd678ba1b98cd7f98bb78b222637573
 # Preserve Ampere support unless a caller selects narrower TE build targets.
 ARG NVTE_CUDA_ARCHS="80;90;100"
 # TE compiles each source's GPU targets one after another by default (nvcc --threads 1), so
@@ -212,11 +208,6 @@ RUN --mount=type=cache,id=uv-${TARGETARCH}-${NVTE_CUDA_ARCHS},target=/root/.cach
     cp /workspace/mamba-cxx20.patch /opt/mamba-build-info/
     rm -rf "${MAMBA_BUILD_DIR}"
     trap - EXIT
-
-    if [ -n "$CUDNN_FRONTEND_GIT_REF" ] && [ "$IMAGE_TYPE" != "lts" ]; then
-        uv pip install --no-deps --reinstall \
-            "nvidia-cudnn-frontend @ git+https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend.git@${CUDNN_FRONTEND_GIT_REF}"
-    fi
 EOF
 
 # Reuse the wheel without copying a second archive into the final image.

@@ -104,7 +104,7 @@ dev = [
     "av",
     "Pillow>=13.0.0",
     "flashinfer-python>=0.5.0,<0.7.0",
-    "nvidia-cudnn-frontend[cutedsl]==1.29.0",
+    "nvidia-cudnn-frontend[cutedsl]==1.29.1",
     "wget",
     "onnxscript",
     "fastapi~=0.50",                                    # Forcing a little bit more recent version of fastapi to be compatible with pydantic 2.0

@@ -2751,7 +2751,7 @@ requires-dist = [
     { name = "nemo-lens", marker = "extra == 'dev'", git = "https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Lens.git?rev=b85578fc2b736a1804705e537001b5f45e9c715d" },
     { name = "nemo-lens", extras = ["sdk"], marker = "extra == 'otel'", git = "https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Lens.git?rev=b85578fc2b736a1804705e537001b5f45e9c715d" },
     { name = "numpy" },
-    { name = "nvidia-cudnn-frontend", extras = ["cutedsl"], marker = "extra == 'dev'", specifier = "==1.29.0" },
+    { name = "nvidia-cudnn-frontend", extras = ["cutedsl"], marker = "extra == 'dev'", specifier = "==1.29.1" },

     { name = "nvidia-resiliency-ext", marker = "extra == 'dev'", specifier = "==0.7.0" },
     { name = "omegaconf", marker = "extra == 'mlm'" },
